toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Headset stand (synthetic example) priced under demo-direct rule as of 2026-10-24. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount scenario for each. Base costs total BRL 24.6667 and rule charges a 10% revenue-based channel fee plus BRL 2 fixed fee, with zero tax and advertising. Undiscounted recommended prices: BRL 38.10 (20%), BRL 44.45 (30%), BRL 53.34 (40%). With 10% discount, charged prices become BRL 34.29, BRL 40.01, and BRL 48.01; all discounted cases miss the requested revenue margin, with realized margins of about 12.23%, 23.35%, and 34.46% respectively.
assumptions: Product and rule are both demonstration fixtures and confirmed by provenance as synthetic, valid 2026-10-24 through 2026-10-26.
All charges in the rule are revenue-basis charges: 10% channel rate, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Discount rate is 10% applied to the recommended price for the discounted scenario.
Failure provision follows the stored product failure rate and full-print retry assumption embedded in the deterministic calculation.
limitations: Full-print retry assumption applies to failures; no partial salvage or rework recovery is modeled.
No marketplace verification is available for the synthetic channel rule.
Contribution is not net profit; prices are drafts only and require human approval.
